name: M3 tools
description: Export EDAs, list mashups, Ming.le workspaces and widgets, search XtendM3 code.

status.edge_opened: Edge is open: sign in, then open the relevant screen if needed.

hint.eda: Opens Edge on the M3 URL above.
hint.mashup: Opens Edge on the tenant’s H5 Administration.
hint.xtend: Opens Edge on the tenant’s XtendM3 administration.
hint.workspaces: Opens Edge on the tenant’s Ming.le portal.

eda.list: EDAs to export (one per line, or paste the first column of a table)
eda.target: One JSON file per EDA in {dir}\eda

widgets.tokenTitle: Sign in with a token (if capturing it in Edge is not enough)
widgets.tokenHelp: Copy the value of the x-infor-authorization header of a workspace/list request from the browser developer tools. The token expires after about 1 hour and is not kept.

xtend.filter: Filter on program, name or description…
xtend.searchHelp: The search reads the {dir}\xtend folder, without any network call.
xtend.hits: {count} results. Click a line to open the code.

errors.network_error: Network error: the server cannot be reached.
errors.http_error: The server answered with an error.
errors.invalid_tenant: Invalid tenant: letters, digits, “-” and “_” only.
errors.login_timeout: Timed out: no M3 request seen. Open the relevant screen in Edge.
errors.edge_launch_failed: Cannot start Edge (already open with Wrench’s profile, or not installed?).
errors.edge_closed: Edge was closed before the login finished.
errors.no_session: No session read: try connecting again.
errors.nothing_to_export: Nothing to export: run an analysis first.
errors.unknown_file: This code file cannot be found.
errors.empty_query: Enter some text to search for.

tabHelp.eda: Exports each EDA definition as JSON.
tabHelp.mashup: Lists the tenant’s apps (mashups), with filter and sort.
tabHelp.widgets: Counts the widgets used in workspaces and insights.
tabHelp.xtend: Fetches the XtendM3 Groovy code, then browses it offline.
